annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Annexes I, II, IV and V to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards technical requirements for vehicles produced in unlimited series, small series, fully automated vehicles in small series, special purpose vehicles, and software update
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Annexes I, II, IV and V to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards technical requirements for vehicles produced in unlimited series, small series, fully automated vehicles in small series, special purpose vehicles, and software update
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 296/1
annotation.summary_en: Binding EU delegated regulation amending the type-approval framework (Regulation 2018/858) for motor vehicles. It sets requirements for small-series and special-purpose vehicles, adds a type-approval scheme for fully automated vehicles in small series (ADS, remote intervention), and makes UN Regulation 156 on software updates mandatory.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds type-approval requirements for fully automated vehicles produced in small series (annual limit 1,500 units).
Makes UN Regulation No 156 software update management mandatory for type-approval from 2022, with registration bans from 2024/2026/2029.
Aligns small-series and special-purpose vehicle requirements with Regulation (EU) 2019/2144, including cyberattack protection.
Commission to adopt requirements for unlimited-series fully automated vehicles by July 2024.
Applies to new vehicle types from 7 July 2024 and all new vehicles from 7 July 2026.
